observed.clothing: A short, form-fitting dress with a dark green upper bodice and a black-and-yellow floral skirt, plus bright blue sneakers.
observed.hairstyle: Blonde hair pulled back into a low bun at the nape of the neck.
observed.identity: A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and tanned skin, shown mostly from behind and in profile.
